_game: ViZDoom: Deadly Corridor (Doom action-shooter; COOM engine) -- full movement
_note: pip install vizdoom. Fight down a corridor to the vest at the end; enemies attack from side alcoves. Unlike DefendCenter this scenario HAS move buttons, so you can walk forward/back and strafe.
_keys_note: For VizdoomDeadlyCorridor-v1 the Discrete(8) map is 0=noop, 1=TURN_RIGHT, 2=TURN_LEFT, 3=MOVE_BACKWARD, 4=MOVE_FORWARD, 5=ATTACK, 6=MOVE_RIGHT, 7=MOVE_LEFT (verify with env.unwrapped.button_map). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase; keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: Fight your way down the corridor to the green
